info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Case Management API
info.description: The Customer Case Management API enables businesses to create and manage customer cases effectively. This endpoint allows for the submission of new customer cases, facilitating streamlined customer service operations. Typical consumers of this API include customer support teams and service management platforms. With this API, organizations can enhance their customer support and track the resolution of individual cases to ensure high-quality service delivery.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new customer case in the servicing system. Ensure all required fields are filled in the request body to successfully create the case.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update a customer case. It should contain the necessary details required for processing the customer case efficiently.
